QUOTE: `enumerate_tree` (`treescan.py:203`) is deliberately not extension-filtered. It hashes every file under the roots so that any change forces a re-run.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says doxygen's fixed FILE_PATTERNS decide parsing, but it never names the parse-built front end claiming file types doxygen can't read or binary classification dropping files with misleading extensions. It also says nothing is extension-filtered.
